biography: With over 25 years of experience in the cloud and IT industry, I am a passionate and strategic leader who drives innovative and customer-centric solutions across the Asia-Pacific region. As the VP Global Technical Sales - APAC at Equinix, I lead a team of technical experts who partner with hyperscale, enterprise, and service provider customers to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable cloud and IT services. I leverage my expertise in SaaS, solution selling, and cloud computing to create value propositions, negotiate contracts, and close deals that generate revenue and growth for Equinix and its clients. Previously, I held various senior roles at Equinix, including VSD Cloud and IT/Interim Sales Leader - Japan, and Senior Commercial Director - Hyperscale APAC, where I successfully launched and managed key accounts, projects, and initiatives in the region. I am committed to fostering a collaborative and inclusive culture that empowers my team, partners, and customers to achieve their goals and thrive in the digital economy.
